task_meta.downstream_task: Distinguish healthy controls (HC) from patients with depression-related disorders (PT)
task_meta.goal: Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.

request: Androids-Corpus-R comprises recordings from 118 native Italian speakers classified as healthy controls (HC) or patients (PT) with depression-related disorders. Reading recordings (54 HC, 58 PT) were collected using Aesop’s fable 'The North Wind and the Sun'. Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
reflections: Resyn: The user requests anonymization of Italian depression-detection recordings, skips masking, and asks to compare all methods. Related Androids-Corpus-I and MODMA runs suggest Resyn gives the best or most relevant downstream depression-detection performance, so start there. Then run formant_lpc, formant_spec, pitch, and NeuralVC in sequence and evaluate.
